subject: spanish
title: Contemporary Identity
welcome_lead: Latin American identity today: migration, urbanisation, globalisation, political movements. Identity is dynamic, contested.
meta_desc: IBDP Spanish: contemporary Latin American identity, migration, urbanisation.
final_note: La identidad latinoamericana se hace y se rehace cada dia.

concepts.def: Latino — of Latin American origin (esp. US).

walkthroughs.body_html: Over 60 million Latinos in the US — Mexican, Cuban, Puerto Rican, Salvadoran. Spanish is the second language of the US.
Ni una menos began in Argentina 2015 against femicide. The slogan spread across the continent — feminism with regional voice.
Latin America is 80% urban. Mexico City, Sao Paulo (Portuguese), Buenos Aires, Lima are mega-cities reshaping identity.
